title: Best ChatGPT Apps for Job Search in 2026, From Résumés to Applications
summary: Compare ChatGPT job-search connections for finding roles, tailoring résumés, starting applications and tracking results. Apps, plugins and custom GPTs…
body_markdown:
**Yes, ChatGPT can start job applications when connected to a service that exposes application tools.** Tsenta, JobGPT and LoopCV document that kind of connection. Joblet’s ChatGPT plugin focuses on finding roles, while a résumé-focused custom GPT may help write a document without having any ability to submit it.


Updated November 5, 2026. Tsenta publishes this guide and sells one of the services. We checked provider documentation and OpenAI’s current custom-MCP instructions; we did not complete signed-in application runs in every product. This is a workflow comparison, not a ranking by interviews or hires.


## Apps, plugins, MCP connections and custom GPTs


Job seekers often search for “ChatGPT apps” or “connectors.” OpenAI’s[current custom-MCP documentation](https://developers.openai.com/plugins/deploy/connect-chatgpt) uses **Plugins** and **Add custom MCP server** . A service can have a directory installation route or require you to add its server yourself. Account and workspace policies still apply.


A **custom GPT** is a configured assistant. A **connected service** supplies tools and data the assistant can use. A GPT’s résumé advice does not imply it can access current jobs, send applications or read your tracker. Confirm what is connected before delegating an action.

## 1. Tsenta: supported applications and follow-up


Tsenta’s MCP server connects ChatGPT to your Tsenta account. The assistant can get matching roles, inspect job details, start supported applications and read their status. It can also work with résumé profiles, tracker entries and inbox messages. Some tools change account data or send replies, so review the access request carefully.


An application call queues work. It does not mean the employer has already received it. Résumé and compatible-form review controls can still pause the workflow; Auto Apply uses separate controls. Check the eventual status and application record.


The same Tsenta allowance applies across the dashboard and connected assistant. The first 25 applications are free with no card. Global USD monthly plans start at $19 for 600 applications per 30-day cycle; see[pricing](https://tsenta.com/pricing) for other plans, markets and billing periods.


### Connect Tsenta to ChatGPT


1. Complete your Tsenta profile and résumé in the dashboard, including location and work authorization.
2. Follow[Tsenta’s current ChatGPT instructions](https://tsenta.com/mcp) . In the current OpenAI guide, open **Plugins** , select **+** , then **Add custom MCP server** .
3. Use` https://api.autojobs.me/api/v1/mcp` as the connection URL and complete the sign-in/authentication flow. Review the discovered tools and access request.
4. Install the resulting plugin, start a chat and select it with` @` when that control is available.
5. Begin with “Show me three matching jobs and explain their requirements.” Choose one before asking it to apply.


The available controls depend on your ChatGPT account and workspace. We have not established a Tsenta public app-directory listing or universal access on every plan. Follow the linked instructions if your interface differs.


## 2. JobGPT: application tools with résumé generation


[JobGPT’s own MCP repository](https://github.com/6figr-com/jobgpt-mcp-server) documents search, résumé generation, saved job hunts, application actions and tracking. It provides a hosted endpoint and authentication options, plus examples of ChatGPT access. Its client screenshots or menu names can lag OpenAI’s current interface, so cross-check the host guide.


Some actions use credits. Verify the current price, supported employers and result detail before starting a batch. An importable job URL does not prove full submission coverage for the site it came from.


## 3. LoopCV: a documented ChatGPT application workflow


[LoopCV’s apply-with-ChatGPT page](https://www.loopcv.pro/apply-with-chatgpt/) describes an MCP connection that searches, matches roles, customizes applications and submits through its service. Its examples include asking for application status and recent responses.


The setup uses a LoopCV account and account key according to that page. Its[pricing page](https://www.loopcv.pro/pricing/) lists free access and paid plans from €9.99 a month, but did not publish exact application allowances for every tier in the page we reviewed. Check the connection details shown in your account and compare actual completed applications with the allowance you buy.


## 4. Joblet: conversational discovery with a direct installation route


[Joblet’s official ChatGPT plugin page](https://joblet.ai/chatgpt-plugin) links to its installation and says you can search by title, skills, company, location, remote preference and employment type, refine results and open full job listings. It explicitly states that the plugin supports discovery and does not submit applications automatically.


Choose it when you want a conversation to lead to a short list of real roles. Open the full listing to verify requirements and use its official application route. Do not count a job card as a sent application.


## What about LinkedIn, Indeed, Teal and résumé GPTs?


They can be useful elsewhere in your search, but this review did not establish an official ChatGPT installation and submission workflow for each of them. A search result mentioning LinkedIn or Indeed is not proof that ChatGPT has access to your account or permission to apply through it. Teal’s standalone résumé and tracking tools likewise do not establish a ChatGPT app.


For a résumé GPT, inspect its publisher, privacy terms and connected actions. Ask it to explain edits and mark missing facts rather than inventing experience. Use a verified application service separately if the GPT has no submission tool.


## A practical ChatGPT job-search workflow


Use conversation to narrow the role criteria, then inspect the actual posting. Ask which facts the assistant lacks, select the résumé and confirm the intended employer and role. After an application request, retrieve its final status rather than assuming the chat message proves delivery.


For tracking, ask for applications that need a next action and the evidence behind each status. If an email tool is involved, check whether it can read or send messages and which account it uses. Keep your profile accurate and use small reviewed runs before expanding volume. Our[MCP server comparison](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-mcp-servers-job-search-2026) covers the broader client options.


## Frequently asked questions


### Is there a ChatGPT app or connector that applies to jobs for me?


Yes. Tsenta’s custom MCP connection exposes tools that start supported cloud applications, and JobGPT and LoopCV also document application workflows. Verify that the service is connected, approve the intended action and inspect the final result.


### Can a ChatGPT app connector apply to jobs automatically?


It can when the connected service provides submission tools and the account permits them. A search-only plugin or résumé GPT cannot submit just because it can describe a role. Product review settings, limits and missing information can still pause work.


### What are the best ChatGPT apps for job search?


Tsenta is our pick for supported applications and follow-up. JobGPT and LoopCV document application workflows, while Joblet provides conversational job discovery. Choose based on the action you need and the setup available in your account.


### Does ChatGPT have a LinkedIn or Indeed integration that applies for me?


This guide does not establish an official LinkedIn or Indeed ChatGPT submission integration. Search results and links to their listings are different from connected access to your account or a completed application.


### What are the top ChatGPT apps for job hunting and resume building?


Tsenta and JobGPT document résumé-related tools alongside applications; LoopCV advertises per-posting customization. Résumé-focused custom GPTs can help draft and critique text, but submission and tracking require connected tools. Verify the specific publisher and capabilities.


### Is a custom GPT the same as an app connected through MCP?


No. A custom GPT configures an assistant. An MCP connection provides external tools and data. A GPT may use connected actions, but its name or description alone does not establish live job search, application submission or tracking.
